cues: Remove the wall, and the molecules spread out through the whole box.
They never all gather back on one side.
There are vastly more ways to be spread out than to be bunched up.
text: Watch the gas. Remove the wall, and the molecules spread out through the whole box. They never all gather back on one side. There are vastly more ways to be spread out than to be bunched up. Nature drifts towards disorder.
